answer: Every identity must lock a jade deposit before it can trade. To enter the market it crosses a canyon gate where a random jury re-verifies its past work: honest agents pass cheaply and reclaim the deposit, while a caught fake loses the whole stake and must fund a new voyage through the gate. A Sybil attacker therefore pays a fresh deposit plus a fresh verification voyage per fake identity, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand deposits while the gate stays narrow.
